title: Welcome to BizJet Pilot
summary: Introducing a dedicated home for Business Jet flight simulation news, reviews, tutorials and live streams.
body:
Welcome to BizJet Pilot, an independent resource for business aviation in the world of Flight Simulation.

Here you'll find Live Stream information, news, hands-on reviews and practical tutorials focused on Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and X-Plane 12.

This website is in its launch phase. More content will be added as our coverage develops.
